schema.name: marketplace_categories_historical_source_idx
schema.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX marketplace_categories_historical_source_idx ON public.marketplace_categories USING btree (source_snapshot_hash, source_sheet, source_row_ordinal) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE (record_origin = 'HISTORICAL_IMPORT'::text)

schema.name: marketplace_categories_history
schema.definition: CHECK ((((record_origin = 'HISTORICAL_IMPORT'::text) AND (source_sheet IS NOT NULL) AND (source_row_ordinal > 1) AND (source_snapshot_hash ~ '^[A-F0-9]{64}$'::text)) OR ((record_origin = 'ADMIN_PHASE3'::text) AND (source_sheet IS NULL) AND (source_row_ordinal IS NULL) AND (source_snapshot_hash IS NULL))))

schema.name: marketplace_categories_image_asset_id_fkey
schema.definition: FOREIGN KEY (image_asset_id) REFERENCES app_assets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

schema.name: marketplace_categories_parent_id_fkey
schema.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES marketplace_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

schema.name: marketplace_categories_parent_sort_idx
schema.definition: CREATE INDEX marketplace_categories_parent_sort_idx ON public.marketplace_categories USING btree (parent_id, enabled, sort_order)

schema.name: marketplace_categories_pkey
schema.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX marketplace_categories_pkey ON public.marketplace_categories USING btree (id)

schema.name: marketplace_categories_slug_key
schema.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX marketplace_categories_slug_key ON public.marketplace_categories USING btree (slug)
